description: Test suite for board storage operations in the focalboard project, including CRUD, history, membership, and search functionalities.

methods.name: StoreTestBoardStore
methods.description: Runs a series of subtests to verify board storage operations including CRUD, membership, history, and search.

methods.name: testGetBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving a board by ID, including existing and non-existing cases.

methods.name: testGetBoardsForUserAndTeam
methods.description: Tests retrieving boards for a user within a team, including filtering by membership and privacy.

methods.name: testGetBoardsInTeamByIds
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple boards by IDs within a team, including error cases for missing IDs.

methods.name: testInsertBoard
methods.description: Tests inserting new boards with various properties, including validation and updates.

methods.name: testPatchBoard
methods.description: Tests applying patches to boards, including property updates, type changes, and error handling.

methods.name: testDeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests deleting boards and verifying their removal.

methods.name: testInsertBoardWithAdmin
methods.description: Tests creating a board with an admin membership.

methods.name: testSaveMember
methods.description: Tests creating and updating board members, including history tracking.

methods.name: testGetMemberForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific board member, including non-existent cases.

methods.name: testGetMembersForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving all members of a board.

methods.name: testGetMembersForUser
methods.description: Tests retrieving all boards a user is a member of.

methods.name: testDeleteMember
methods.description: Tests deleting a board member and verifying history updates.

methods.name: testSearchBoardsForUser
methods.description: Tests searching for boards by term and filters, including property searches.

methods.name: testSearchBoardsForUserInTeam
methods.description: Tests searching for boards within a team.

methods.name: testUndeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests restoring a deleted board and verifying data integrity.

methods.name: testGetBoardHistory
methods.description: Tests retrieving the history of a board, including creation, updates, and deletion.

methods.name: testGetBoardCount
methods.description: Tests counting total boards in the store.
